name: attract-button

frames.best_why: The cursor sits on the button and the surrounding filings have turned to point at it, the clearest magnetic state.

tagline: Iron filings around a call to action swing toward the cursor.
summary: A dark rounded call-to-action button with a magnet icon, ringed by a field of small iron filings drawn on a canvas. Moving the pointer nearby makes the filings rotate to point at it, and focussing the button pulls them inward.
appearance: A white, slightly rounded rectangular button with a small magnet icon and the label Join the waitlist, floating on a dark stage. Short dark grey dashes radiate outward in a loose ring around it, with a grey caption below.
behaviour: At rest the filings hold a radial pattern with a slight jitter. When the pointer comes near they rotate on a spring to point toward it and brighten, and focussing the button pulls the whole field inward.
demo_content: Button label Join the waitlist and the caption "Bring the cursor close and the filings line up."
use_when: A hero or waitlist needs a memorable primary button that reacts to the pointer without a big animation.
avoid_when: The canvas field reaches far past the button and needs spare space; on touch it only runs while pressed.
customise: Props set filing density, field radius, container classes and normal button attributes; the filings' physics, ink colour and spring constants need a source edit.
weight_why: A few hundred short lines drawn only while the field is settling.

a11y.note: The button and its focus ring are solid; the canvas is hidden from assistive tech and reduced-motion leaves a static field.

issues: The filings are faint at rest and nearly disappear against the dark stage.
polish_why: Distinctive, well-behaved magnetic detail; faint filings and a plain button shape.
title: Attract Button
